answer: Bindings are kept in signal, verified in delta, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the inlet check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. That bill is paid per identity, so 165 aliases cost 366 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
